name: Circus of the Moon
source:
Play as Elise Berrie, a tightrope walker marked by a broken past. As she infiltrates the enigmatic Circus of the Moon, she discovers that beneath its magic lie unsettling secrets. Between performances and haunting dreams, every step may bring her closer to the truth… or make her disappear.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2381570/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
扮演埃莉斯·贝里 (Elise Berrie)，一名走钢丝的人，有着破碎的过去。当她潜入神秘的月亮马戏团时，她发现其魔法之下隐藏着令人不安的秘密。在表演和萦绕心头的梦境之间，每一步都可能让她更接近真相……或者让她消失。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2381570/]Steam[/url]]
